```lean
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Factorial
import Mathlib.Tactic

open Filter

theorem lg_target {p : ℕ → ℝ} {r : ℝ} (k : ℕ)
  (hr : Tendsto (fun n => ↑n * p n) atTop (nhds r)) :
  Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k) atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑k.factorial)) := by
  let n : ℕ := n
  let k : ℕ := k
  let r : ℝ := r

  -- Step 1: Express binomial coefficient in terms of factorials
  have h_binom : ∀ n, ↑(n.choose k) = ↑n! / (↑k! * ↑(n - k)!) := by
    intro n
    rw [Nat.choose_def]
    rw [Nat.factorial_div_factorial]

  -- Step 2: Use asymptotic approximation for p(n): n * p(n) → r ⇒ p(n) ≈ r / n
  have h_p_approx : Tendsto (fun n => p n - r / ↑n) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    rw [Tendsto.sub] at hr
    rw [Tendsto.const_mul] at hr
    rw [Tendsto.mul_right] at hr
    exact hr

  -- Step 3: Expand p(n)^k using the approximation p(n) ≈ r / n
  have h_p_pow_k : Tendsto (fun n => (p n)^k - (r^k / ↑n^k)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    let f : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => p n
    let g : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => r / ↑n
    have hf : Tendsto f atTop (nhds r / ↑n) := h_p_approx
    have hg : Tendsto g atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_div_pow r k (by simp)
    have hfg : Tendsto (fun n => f n - g n) atTop (nhds 0) := h_p_approx
    have hfg_pow : Tendsto (fun n => (f n - g n) * (f n ^ (k - 1) + ... + g n ^ k)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
      apply tendsto_zero_of_le
      intros ε hε
      let ε' : ℝ := ε / k
      have hε' : 0 < ε' := by linarith
      let δ : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => max (1 / ε') (1 / (ε' * ↑k))
      have hδ : ∀ n ≥ δ n, |(f n - g n) * (f n ^ (k - 1) + ... + g n ^ k)| ≤ ε := by
        assume n hnpos
        have h1 : |f n - g n| ≤ ε' := by
          apply tendsto_zero.mp hfg
          exact ⟨n, hnpos⟩
        have h2 : |f n ^ (k - 1) + ... + g n ^ k| ≤ k * max (|f n ^ (k - 1)|) (|g n ^ k|) := by
          sorry
        have h3 : |f n ^ (k - 1)| ≤ (|r| / ↑n) ^ (k - 1) + |(f n - g n)| * (k - 1) * max (|f n ^ (k - 2)|) (|g n ^ (k - 1)|) := by
          sorry
        have h4 : |g n ^ k| ≤ (|r| / ↑n) ^ k := by
          sorry
        have h5 : |f n ^ (k - 1) + ... + g n ^ k| ≤ k * (|r| / ↑n) ^ (k - 1) + k * |f n - g n| * (|r| / ↑n) ^ (k - 2) := by
          sorry
        have h6 : k * (|r| / ↑n) ^ (k - 1) + k * |f n - g n| * (|r| / ↑n) ^ (k - 2) ≤ ε := by
          sorry
        exact h6
      exact hδ

  -- Step 4: Combine with binomial coefficient and apply asymptotic behavior
  have h_combination : Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k - (r^k / ↑k!)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
    let a : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * p n ^ k
    let b : ℕ → ℝ := fun n => r^k / ↑k!
    have ha : Tendsto a atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑k!)) := by
      have h1 : Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k)) atTop (nhds (1 / ↑k!)) := by
        have h1a : Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k)) atTop (nhds (1 / ↑k!)) := by
          have h1b : Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k) * ↑(n - k)!) atTop (nhds ↑n!) := by
            sorry
          have h1c : Tendsto (fun n => ↑k! * ↑(n - k)!) atTop (nhds ↑n!) := by
            sorry
          have h1d : Tendsto (fun n => ↑(n.choose k)) atTop (nhds (1 / ↑k!)) := by
            exact (h1b.prod h1c).div
        exact h1a
      have h2 : Tendsto (fun n => p n ^ k) atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑n^k)) := by
        have h2a : Tendsto (fun n => p n ^ k) atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑n^k)) := by
          have h2b : Tendsto (fun n => p n) atTop (nhds (r / ↑n)) := h_p_approx
          have h2c : Tendsto (fun n => (r / ↑n)^k) atTop (nhds 0) := by
            have h2d : Tendsto (fun n => r / ↑n) atTop (nhds 0) := tendsto_const_div_pow r k (by simp)
            exact h2d.pow k
          exact (h2b.pow k).sub h2c
        exact h2a
      have h3 : Tendsto (fun n => (r^k / ↑n^k) * (1 / ↑k!)) atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑k!)) := by
        have h3a : Tendsto (fun n => r^k / ↑n^k) atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h3b : Tendsto (fun n => r^k) atTop (nhds r^k) := by
            exact rfl
          have h3c : Tendsto (fun n => ↑n^k) atTop (nhds ∞) := by
            exact tendsto_pow_at_top_nat k
          have h3d : Tendsto (fun n => r^k / ↑n^k) atTop (nhds 0) := by
            exact (h3b.div h3c)
        have h3e : Tendsto (fun n => (r^k / ↑n^k) * (1 / ↑k!)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
          have h3f : Tendsto (fun n => 1 / ↑k!) atTop (nhds (1 / ↑k!)) := by
            exact rfl
          have h3g : Tendsto (fun n => (r^k / ↑n^k) * (1 / ↑k!)) atTop (nhds 0) := by
            exact (h3d.mul h3f)
        exact h3g
      exact (h1.prod h2).sub h3
    have hb : Tendsto b atTop (nhds (r^k / ↑k!)) := by
      exact rfl
    exact (ha.prod hb).sub
```
